topic: a task worktree is cut from master, not from the story branch
lesson: forge task start branches the task worktree from MASTER and seeds only the story's .factory artifacts and active plan, so the story's own commits - newly accepted decision records, an amended spec, an amended earlier decision - are ABSENT from the tree the implementer reads and from the delegate brief's 'Active decisions' section, which is built from the tree. Merge the story branch into the task branch immediately after task start and verify the decisions this task depends on are present before delegating; the seeded .factory copies are byte-identical to the story branch's, so staging them first lets the merge proceed.
source: mis-statement statement-model task start; the same class surfaced at the mis-selection closeout, where master turned out to be missing decisions 0017-0019
